description: Action reuse assessment: extend NotifyPerson, Engine.Api notify_person and Notifications/Notification optional attachments contract; reuse Channels delivery and Record.from_map verification. Preserve text-only defaults, exact recipient routing and fallback. Carry TrustedContext actor and explicit bypass through role event builders; never accept identity from attachment params. Keep attachments runtime-only in Notification, outside notification_logs payload. Validate signed file Records and use existing Channels materialization authorization. Add contract/security tests. Module context: Action owns input dispatch; Engine.Api projects envelope; Notifications owns routing/audit; Channels owns file transport/materialization; Record owns signature validation. Risk: identity loss and JSONB map round trips. Existing channel byte tests prove adapters; new workflow tests prove consumer propagation.
title: [zaq-0z7] Carry authorized attachments through notification delivery
